name: Scarnose International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2011, Scarnose International Ltd is in the business of trading of Textile products[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
Company manufactures a range of soft and durable cotton products including Cotton Bales, Yarn, Fabrics, Clothes, and beddings.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.08% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.92% over last 3 years.
